rec-e1.subject: Re o boloketse sebaka sa hao ho Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Dumela {name},

O qadile ho ingodisetsa {plan} mme wa kgaotsa pele feela o qeta.

Re o boloketse tsohle, mme o ka tswela pele hantle moo o kgaoditseng teng.

- Matsatsi a 14 mahala, mme ha ho lefiswe letho kajeno
- Ka mora nako ya teko: {price}
- Re tla o romella kgopotso ka imeile pele nako ya teko e fela
- O ka emisa nako efe kapa efe leqepheng la hao la akhaonte, ka ho tobetsa habedi
rec-e1.next: Ho na le ho sa hlakang? Araba feela imeile ena, mme re tla o thusa.

rec-e2-family.subject: Seo bana ba hao ba se fumanang ho Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Re ne re batla ho o bolella ka bokgutshwane seo se emetseng bana ba hao ho Gadit:

Lentswe le leng le le leng leo ba kopanang le lona, bukeng, mosebetsing wa hae kapa moqoqong, le fetoha lentswe leo ba le utlwisisang ka nnete.

- Tlhaloso e lekaneng ngwana wa hao, e nang le setshwantsho bakeng sa moelelo o mong le o mong
- Dipapadi le boikwetliso tse entsweng ka mantswe a bona
- Thuso ka mosebetsi wa hae
- Leqephe la taolo la motswadi le o bontshang tswelopele ya ngwana e mong le e mong

Ngodiso ya hao ya {plan} e bolokilwe, mme ho setse feela mohato wa ho qetela.
rec-e2-family.next: Ha ho lefiswe letho kajeno, mme o ka emisa nako efe kapa efe leqepheng la hao la akhaonte.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Seo se o emetseng ho Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Re ne re batla ho o bolella ka bokgutshwane seo se o emetseng ho Gadit:

Lentswe le leng le le leng, bukeng, mosebetsing kapa moqoqong, le fetoha lentswe leo o le utlwisisang ka botlalo.

- Meelelo yohle ya lentswe, ka setshwantsho bakeng sa o mong le o mong
- Dipapadi le boikwetliso tse entsweng ka mantswe a hao
- Bukana ya hao ya mantswe e bolokang tsohle tseo o ithutileng tsona

Ngodiso ya hao ya {plan} e bolokilwe, mme ho setse feela mohato wa ho qetela.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Ha ho lefiswe letho kajeno, mme o ka emisa nako efe kapa efe leqepheng la hao la akhaonte.

rec-e3.subject: Na ho na le se o sitisitseng? Re bolelle
rec-e3.body:
Dumela {name},

Ngodiso ya hao ya {plan} e ntse e bolokilwe.

Haeba ho na le se o thibelang, araba feela imeile ena, mme re tla o thusa.

act-first-word-family.subject: Lentswe la pele la bana ba hao ho Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Tsela e molemohadi ya ho qala: dula le ngwana wa hao metsotso e mehlano, le batle lentswe le le leng leo a kopaneng le lona kajeno, bukeng, mosebetsing wa hae kapa moqoqong.

- Ngola lentswe sebakeng sa ho batla
- Bona tlhaloso e lekaneng ngwana wa hao, e nang le setshwantsho bakeng sa moelelo o mong le o mong
- Le boloke bukaneng ya mantswe, mme ho tloha moo le kena dipapading tsa hae

Lentswe le le leng kajeno, mme ngwana wa hao o se a qala ho aha tsebo ya hae ya mantswe.
act-first-word-family.next: O hloka thuso? Araba feela imeile ena.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Lentswe la hao la pele ho Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Tsela e molemohadi ya ho qala: batla lentswe le le leng leo o kopaneng le lona kajeno, bukeng, mosebetsing kapa moqoqong.

- Meelelo yohle ya lona, ka setshwantsho bakeng sa o mong le o mong
- Moo lentswe le tswang teng
- Le boloke bukaneng ya hao ya mantswe mme o ikwetlise ka lona ka dipapadi tse kgutshwane

Lentswe le le leng kajeno, mme tsebo ya hao ya mantswe e se e ntse e hola.
act-first-word-indiv.next: O hloka thuso? Araba feela imeile ena.

act-first-word-2.subject: Lentswe le le leng, metsotso e mehlano
act-first-word-2.body:
Dumela {name},

Mohopolo o monyane wa kajeno: kgetha lentswe le le leng bukeng, mosebetsing wa hae kapa ditabeng, mme o le batle ho Gadit.

Ka motsotso feela o bona meelelo yohle ya lona, ka setshwantsho le mehlala, mme le bolokwa bukaneng ya mantswe hore o ikwetlise.

Ke ka tsela ena tsebo ya mantswe e holang ka yona: lentswe le le leng ka nako.
act-first-word-2.next: O hloka thuso? Araba feela imeile ena.

act-add-child.subject: Mohato o mong hape: eketsa ngwana wa hao
act-add-child.body:
Dumela {name},

Gadit Family e etseditswe bana ba hao, mme ha ho so be le ngwana ya ekeditsweng akhaonteng. Ho nka motsotso:

- Ngola lebitso la ngwana wa hao mme o kgethe sebapali
- Hokela sesebediswa sa hae ntle le phasewete, kapa o sebedise Mokgwa wa bana sesebedisweng sa hao
- Ho tloha moo lentswe le leng le le leng leo a le batlang le a bolokwa, mme o bona tswelopele leqepheng la taolo la motswadi
act-add-child.next: O hloka thuso? Araba feela imeile ena.

act-return-family.subject: Qalo e kgutshwane ho Gadit, e o etseditsweng
act-return-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Re batla ho netefatsa hore bana ba hao ba fumana tsohle tseo Gadit e ka ba fang tsona. Mehato e meraro e kgutshwane ya ho qala bekeng ena ke ena:

- Eketsa ngwana akhaonteng, haeba o so ka o etsa jwalo (motsotso o le mong)
- Batlang lentswe le le leng mmoho bukeng kapa mosebetsing wa hae
- Bula dipapadi, tse entsweng ka mantswe ao ngwana wa hao a a bolokileng
act-return-family.next: O batla hore re o bontshe hore e sebetsa jwang? Araba imeile ena, mme re tla hlophisa mohala o mokgutshwane wa metsotso e 10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Qalo e kgutshwane ho Gadit, e o etseditsweng
act-return-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Re batla ho netefatsa hore o fumana tsohle tseo Gadit e ka o fang tsona. Mehato e meraro e kgutshwane ya ho qala bekeng ena ke ena:

- Batla lentswe le le leng leo o kopaneng le lona kajeno
- Le boloke bukaneng ya hao ya mantswe
- Ikwetlise mantswe a hao ka dipapadi tse kgutshwane
act-return-indiv.next: O batla hore re o bontshe hore e sebetsa jwang? Araba imeile ena, mme re tla hlophisa mohala o mokgutshwane wa metsotso e 10.
